resources.string: Optional: restrict other apps during class

FocusLock can switch on a temporary, local VPN for this class session only.

 What it does
 • Other apps (Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp…) lose internet access while it is on, on Wi-Fi and on mobile data.
 • FocusLock itself and the class portal keep working.

 What it does NOT do
 • It does not read, log or send anywhere what other apps try to reach. Their packets are dropped on your phone without being looked at.
 • Nothing is routed to any server.

 Your control
 • You can turn it off at any time in Settings → Network → VPN. Your instructor will see that it was turned off. That is all they see.
 • It stops automatically when the class ends, when you tap Exit, or when you tap Emergency.

 Calls
 • Internet calls (WhatsApp, Meet, etc.) are blocked while it is on.
 • Normal phone calls, SMS and emergency calls to 112 still work.

 This is a consent-based restriction, not an unbreakable lock. If you say no, you can still use the class portal.
